fix_guide.title: Terminal Quick Fix (Resolves internal 403s)
fix_guide.step1_desc: Open your Terminal and run the following command to tell Google "it's me", which resolves most 403 blocks:
fix_guide.step1_li1: Press Enter, input <1>Y</1> when prompted to continue.
fix_guide.step1_li2: Your browser will open automatically, select your account and click "Allow".
fix_guide.step1_li3: Once you see <1>You are now authenticated</1>, you're all set!
fix_guide.step2_li1_prefix: Run this to clear your old credentials:
fix_guide.tip1: If you still get 403, try running <1>unset GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS</1> in terminal first.
fix_guide.tip2: For production environments, using a <1>Service Account</1> JSON key is highly recommended for stability and headless operation.
fix_guide.tip3: If it still fails, check the Generative Language API in <1>Google Cloud Console</1> to see if permissions are frozen. If so, your account is under risk control. Please let the account cool down for 72 hours before trying again.
fix_guide.tip4: You can also try <1>npm install -g @google/gemini-cli</1>. If it doesn't throw errors, simply deleting and re-authorizing the account in the app will likely fix it.

thinking_budget.title: Thinking Budget Control
thinking_budget.description: Normalize cross-protocol reasoning parameters and centrally manage thinking token budgets and adaptive behaviors for Gemini and Claude models.
thinking_budget.source_gateway_desc: The gateway centrally regulates thinking budgets and heuristic tiers, eliminating client inconsistencies and preventing upstream 400 errors caused by invalid limits.
thinking_budget.source_client_desc: Extracts client-provided thinking parameters after normalization and forwards them directly. If omitted, upstream dynamic adaptive reasoning is used. Inappropriate values may trigger Google API errors.
thinking_budget.client_warning_title: Warning: Switched to Client Direct Control
thinking_budget.client_warning_desc: Different clients (Cline, Roo, Cherry, etc.) submit varying thinking.budget_tokens or effort values. If a client specifies limits exceeding Google API constraints (e.g. Flash > 24576 or non-standard Pro budgets), Google will return 400 Bad Request.
thinking_budget.flash_family_desc: Manage four tier budgets for Flash reasoning models (enter -1 for official adaptive)
thinking_budget.flash_default_hint: Official default mode enabled: passes model ID directly without injecting thinkingBudget.
thinking_budget.tiered_desc: 💡 Tiered Model Note: Designed for Google's dynamic adaptation. When set to -1, the model allocates reasoning dynamically based on task difficulty; setting 30000+ unlocks Max reasoning beyond High.
thinking_budget.pro_family_desc: Google's Gemini 3.1 Pro architecture officially provides only Low and High tiers. Unspecified effort or medium automatically routes to High for deep reasoning.
thinking_budget.pro_default_hint: Official default mode enabled: Gemini Pro reasoning is determined dynamically by Google.
thinking_budget.claude_family_desc: Claude düşünme modelleri belirteç bütçesi yönetimi (resmi liste yalnızca -thinking ile standart olanları ayırır; bu ayar sadece düşünme modelleri içindir)
thinking_budget.claude_default_hint: Official default mode enabled: adheres to standard Anthropic specifications without custom limits.
thinking_budget.store_enabled: Sunucu Tarafı Düşünce Bloğu ve İmza Geri Yükleme
thinking_budget.store_enabled_desc: Düşünce süreçlerini ve şifrelenmiş imzaları otomatik yakalar ve kalıcı kılar. Ticari ajanlar (Cline, Roo, Claude Code vb.) çok turlu konuşmalarda düşünceyi geri getirmediğinde, ağ geçidi 400 hatalarını veya bağlam kaybını önlemek için bunları otomatik tamamlar.
thinking_budget.claude_thinking_note: 💡 Claude Modelleri Notu: Anthropic resmi modelleri yalnızca `-thinking` ekli olanlar (örn. claude-3-7-sonnet-thinking) ile standart olanlar arasında ayrım yapar. Bu bütçe düşünme modellerini kontrol eder; standart modeller düşünce süreci üretmez.
thinking_budget.max_memory_turns_label: Max Memory Thinking Turns per Session
thinking_budget.max_memory_turns_desc: Controls the maximum number of historical thinking turns kept in RAM per session. Estimated RAM usage per turn is ~1.5 KB - 2.5 KB (~1.2 MB / session for 600 turns).
thinking_budget.window_guide_title: FIFO Sliding Window Eviction & Concurrency Sizing Guide
thinking_budget.window_guide_desc: When session length exceeds this limit, FIFO sliding window automatically evicts oldest thinking blocks from memory. Evicted blocks are rehydrated in nanoseconds via indexed SQLite (primary_tool_id), maintaining strict byte-level Prompt Cache alignment without OOM.
thinking_budget.tooltip_32768: 32,768 Tokens: Ideal for complex coding and deep architecture design
thinking_budget.tooltip_16384: 16K tier (16,384 Tokens): Best for complex agentic workflows
thinking_budget.tooltip_8192: 8,192 Tokens: Balanced for multi-step reasoning and debugging
thinking_budget.tooltip_4096: 4,096 Tokens: Standard balance between reasoning quality and speed
thinking_budget.tooltip_1024: 1,024 Tokens: Ultra-fast lightweight thinking with minimal token usage
thinking_budget.tooltip_65536: 65,536 Tokens: Extreme maximum depth reasoning chain tier
thinking_budget.tooltip_1001: 1,001 Tokens: Google official 3.1 Pro Low thinking baseline
thinking_budget.tooltip_10001: 10,001 Tokens: Google official 3.1 Pro High deep reasoning primary tier
thinking_budget.tooltip_adaptive: Adaptive (-1): Dynamic budget allocated automatically by upstream model
thinking_budget.window_settings_title: Dual-Layer Thinking Sliding Window & Storage Limits (RAM + SQLite)
thinking_budget.claude_budget_desc: Core token budget when client calls thinking models like claude-3-7-sonnet-thinking (-1 for upstream default)
thinking_budget.claude_budget_current: Recommended default: 16,384 Tokens (balanced depth and latency)
thinking_budget.claude_show_advanced: Advanced: Client Effort Tier Mapping (low / medium / high)
thinking_budget.claude_effort_mapping_desc: When commercial agents (Cline, Roo, etc.) send reasoning_effort in parameters or headers, budgets are mapped as follows:
thinking_budget.save_hint: Changes take effect immediately upon saving and are hot-reloaded into the running proxy service.
thinking_budget.max_memory_turns_subdesc: Tur başına ~2 KB; 600 tur ≈ 1.2 MB / oturum.
thinking_budget.retention_days_subdesc: Etkin oturumlar her istekte otomatik uzatılır; yalnızca boşta kaldığında süresi dolar.
thinking_budget.guide_preset_1g_desc: Önerilen: <1>100 ~ 200 tur</1>. Yüzlerce eşzamanlı oturum yalnızca ~50MB RAM tüketir, OOM hatalarına karşı son derece dirençlidir.
thinking_budget.guide_preset_team_desc: Önerilen: <1>600 ~ 1000 tur</1>. Binlerce tur geçmişi fiziksel bellekte kalır ve 0ms yıldırım hızında yanıt verir.
thinking_budget.guide_preset_enterprise_desc: Önerilen: <1>300 ~ 600 tur</1>. İsteklerin %95+'i RAM'e isabet eder, üstün performans ve mutlak kararlılık sunar.
thinking_budget.guide_preset_relay_desc: Önerilen: <1>150 ~ 300 tur</1>. Bellek bağlantı havuzlarına önceliklendirilir, uzun geçmişler SQLite'a devredilir.
thinking_budget.guide_preset_cluster_desc: Önerilen: <1>50 ~ 100 tur</1>. On binlerce eşzamanlı oturumu rahatça barındırır; WAL hızlı dizini kilitsiz anlık yanıt sağlar.

example.title: Kullanım Örnekleri
example.python_anthropic:
from anthropic import Anthropic

client = Anthropic(
    # Önerilen: 127.0.0.1
    base_url="{{baseUrl}}",
    api_key="{{apiKey}}"
)

# Not: Antigravity, Anthropic SDK ile herhangi bir modeli çağırmayı destekler
response = client.messages.create(
    model="{{modelId}}",
    max_tokens=1024,
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Merhaba"}]
)

print(response.content[0].text)
example.python_gemini:
# Kurulum: pip install google-generativeai
import google.generativeai as genai

# Antigravity proxy adresini kullan (önerilen 127.0.0.1)
genai.configure(
    api_key="{{apiKey}}",
    transport='rest',
    client_options={'api_endpoint': '{{rawBaseUrl}}'}
)

model = genai.GenerativeModel('{{modelId}}')
response = model.generate_content("Merhaba")
print(response.text)
example.python_openai_image:
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(
    base_url="{{baseUrl}}",
    api_key="{{apiKey}}"
)

response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="{{modelId}}",
    # Seçenek 1: boyut kullan (önerilen)
    # Desteklenen: "1024x1024" (1:1), "1280x720" (16:9), "720x1280" (9:16), "1216x896" (4:3)
    extra_body={ "size": "1024x1024" },

    # Seçenek 2: model eki kullan
    # örn. gemini-3-pro-image-16-9, gemini-3-pro-image-4-3
    # model="gemini-3-pro-image-16-9",
    messages=[{
        "role": "user",
        "content": "Fütüristik bir şehir çiz"
    }]
)

print(response.choices[0].message.content)
example.python_openai:
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(
    base_url="{{baseUrl}}",
    api_key="{{apiKey}}"
)

response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="{{modelId}}",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Merhaba"}]
)

print(response.choices[0].message.content)
